name: comp-512
title: Date Range Popover Picker
blurb: Button that opens a calendar popover for selecting a date range.
description: A labeled form control showing the selected date range or placeholder. Button displays 'Start - End' format. Popover contains a calendar in range mode for selecting both dates.
use_when: You need a compact date range picker that hides the calendar until clicked.
avoid_when: When users need to see two full months simultaneously to span across months.
a11y: Label properly associated. Keyboard-accessible popover and calendar. aria-live for selections.
